snippets.snippet: 4 Finalize your application A plot plan showing the exact location of your proposed structure is required. Failure to provide a plan with sufficient detail will result in the delay or denial of your permit application. A complete plot plan should include the following: 1. A drawing showing the location and shape of the proposed structure. 2. The distance from the nearest property line if not a fence. 3. The height of any proposed fencing.
